rect.data-description: CFP2-DWDM port 0. A drawn opening, not a composed aperture - see provenance.aperture. The twenty SFP+ ports on the same faceplate ARE composed, from std/sfp.
CFP2-DWDM port 1. A drawn opening, not a composed aperture - see provenance.aperture. The twenty SFP+ ports on the same faceplate ARE composed, from std/sfp.
the CFP2-0 port's A/L lamp, drawn as a 2.51 mm circle above its cage.
the CFP2-1 port's A/L lamp, drawn as a 2.51 mm circle above its cage.

circle.data-description: the card's Status LED. Table 32, 'Port Status and Line Card Status LEDs', of the Ethernet Line Card Installation Guide, section 'Card Status LED (one per card)'. Green: line card has booted properly and is ready to pass or is passing traffic. Steady amber: boot process underway. Blinking amber: software configuration error that prevents the card passing traffic - it may still be passing traffic with some degradation. Red: hardware error, not passing traffic. Off: powered off. Steady and blinking amber share one colour and are not two states; the distinction is recorded because it is the difference between a card booting and a card misconfigured.
